messages.subject: [IRACE - ACOTSP tutorial] Using of instance_id in target runner
messages.subject_clean: [IRACE - ACOTSP tutorial] Using of instance_id in target runner
messages.body_plain:
Dear friends,

Just as a suggestion, I would like to propose the following substitutions in the target runner script:
Where there is SET "stdout=c%candidate%-%instance_id%.stdout", replace by SET "stdout=c%candidate%-%instance_id%-%seed%.stdout". At the same way, replace SET "stderr=c%candidate%-%instance_id%.stderr" by  SET "stderr=c%candidate%-%instance_id%-%seed%.stderr".

The reason for that is a potential overwritting of the output files created by the .exe program called by the target runner. If the IRACE budget is high enough to allow the combination of the same instance with different seeds (see dataframe iraceResults$state$.irace$instancesList), the file name for different pairs (instance_id, seed) would be the same, what can lead to overwritting by the newer over the older file.

This happened to me! :-( But without bad consequences! ;-)))))

Thank you so much!

Best wishes,

André de Souza
